name: io.github.Faheel101/ieltsera-mcp
title: IELTSera — IELTS Band Score, CLB & Writing Coach
description: IELTS Band & CLB calculators, UKVI pathway advisor, Writing analyzer, and 40 strategy guides.

tools.name: calculate_ielts_band_score
tools.description: Calculates official IELTS Overall Band scores (with 0.25/0.75 half-band rounding rules), converts Listening and Academic/General Training Reading raw scores (0-40) into Band scores, computes weighted Writing Band (1/3 Task 1 + 2/3 Task 2), and maps scores to Canadian Language Benchmarks (CLB 4-10) for Express Entry.

examTrack.description: IELTS exam module ('academic' or 'general_training'). Defaults to 'academic'.

listeningBand.description: Listening band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments). Optional if listeningRawCorrect is provided.

listeningRawCorrect.description: Number of correct Listening answers out of 40 (0-40).

readingBand.description: Reading band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments). Optional if readingRawCorrect is provided.

readingRawCorrect.description: Number of correct Reading answers out of 40 (0-40). Uses official Academic vs GT conversion tables.

writingBand.description: Writing band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments). Optional if writingTask1Band and writingTask2Band are provided.

writingTask1Band.description: Writing Task 1 band score (weighted 1/3 of total Writing score).

writingTask2Band.description: Writing Task 2 band score (weighted 2/3 of total Writing score).

speakingBand.description: Speaking band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments).

tools.name: recommend_ielts_pathway
tools.description: Recommends the exact IELTS exam version (IELTS Academic, IELTS General Training, IELTS for UKVI SELT, or IELTS Life Skills A1/A2/B1), required band thresholds, and preparation roadmap based on the candidate's target country and visa/study goal.

destinationCountry.description: Target country for study, work, or migration.

currentOverallBand.description: Optional current estimated overall IELTS band score (0-9).

tools.name: get_ielts_practice_prompt
tools.description: Returns a realistic IELTS practice prompt (Writing Task 2 essay, Academic Task 1 report, General Training Task 1 letter, Speaking Part 1/2/3 cue card, or Reading True/False/Not Given drill) along with a Band 8.0 examiner checklist and a direct deep-link to practice in IELTSera Studio.

taskType.description: Which IELTS task type to fetch.

tools.name: analyze_writing_structure
tools.description: Runs a deterministic IELTS Writing structural, lexical, and register diagnostic on a learner's draft response (Task 2 Essay, Academic Task 1 Report, or General Training Task 1 Letter). Checks word count penalties, paragraph balance, Task 1 Overview presence, GT salutation/sign-off pairing, contraction violations, overused mechanical linkers, and lexical variety.

taskType.description: The IELTS Writing task type being analyzed.

draftText.description: The learner's full draft essay, report, or letter text.

letterTone.description: Optional target tone when taskType is 'gt_task_1' (defaults to 'formal').

tools.name: search_ieltsera_guides
tools.description: Searches IELTSera's 40 expert IELTS strategy guides and examiner playbooks for specific questions, question types, Band 6.0 vs Band 8.0 comparisons, comparison tables, and actionable fixes.

query.description: Search query or IELTS topic (e.g. 'True False Not Given', 'Academic Task 1 overview', 'CLB 9', 'One Skill Retake', 'Speaking Part 2 cue card', 'Band 7 writing').

limit.description: Maximum number of matching guides to return (1 to 5, default 3).

tools.name: get_my_ieltsera_progress
tools.description: Authenticated Tool (Requires IELTSera Personal Access Token): Fetches the connected learner's live IELTSera Band Signal, target band goals, skill-by-skill current estimates (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking), weakest rubric criterion, and today's adaptive study plan tasks.

tools.name: save_vocabulary_flashcard
tools.description: Authenticated Tool (Requires IELTSera Personal Access Token): Saves a vocabulary word or collocation from the conversation into the connected learner's IELTSera spaced-repetition flashcard progress and bookmarks it in their Learning Hub.

term.description: The English word, academic collocation, or card ID to save to the learner's IELTSera vocabulary deck.

contextNote.description: Optional example sentence or usage note discussed during the chat.
